test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest on ₹3,000 as a sum borrowed at 4% per year rate of interest for 5 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per year

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/(100)

**Calculation:**

SI = (P × R × T)/(100)

SI = (3000 × 4 × 5)/(100)

⇒ SI = (60000)/(100)

⇒ SI = ₹600

**The simple interest on ₹3,000 at 4% per year for 5 years is ₹600.**
